description: V7 Go turns documents and unstructured data into structured, queryable information, right inside ChatGPT. Discover and configure workflows, run them over your documents to extract structured fields, search across your files, add documents to knowledge graphs, and query the resulting workflow and context graph data, so you get answers grounded in your own sources.
